messages:
maria: Heads up — my docs PR is blocked. Need confirmation from runtime on prefetch cache + model fallback behavior before merge. cc @jonathan @kevin

jonathan: looking now. which config snippet in the PR is ambiguous?

maria: `docs/guides/prefetch.md` example shows `prefetch_cache: true` and `fallback_model: 'llama-2-13b-quant'` — question: if prefetch cache miss + fallback kicks in, does the KV cache get reset or merged?

kevin: runtime behavior: fallback spins up different backend. KV cache is separate per model instance, so we do NOT merge — we warm the new model's cache, old cache stays. But confirm w/ seq-edgecases. @song?

song: that's correct for 99% cases. edge case: if request uses `preserve_prefix: true` and same tokenizer then we reuse prefix cache via shared-cache key (only in dedicated mode).

maria: aha — the doc needs to mention 'dedicated mode shared-cache' caveat. Also, what's default `preserve_prefix`? docs assume false but runtime default might be true.

jonathan: runtime default: `preserve_prefix=false` unless `session_affinity:true` in route. we should quote exact behavior in docs.

kevin: also note: when fallback is to a quantized variant of same architecture, latency SLOs change — mention expected 10-40ms delta.

maria: ok I'll update the PR. One more: ci preview link? I can't see the rendered snippet with code block.

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR #8421 is available: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-8421 (expires in 72h) :eyes:

maria: thanks. @jonathan can you drop a one-liner we can paste? Prefer something short.

jonathan: paste: 'On fallback, KV caches are per model instance and are not merged; dedicated mode may use shared prefix cache when session_affinity is enabled.'

maria: perfect. I'll add that and ping for final ok. ETA ~30m.

kevin: LGTM after text added. @emma can you quick-review for wording?

emma: on it. will check in 20.

runtime-bot: deploy-check: runtime-config-tests passed (prefetch, fallback unit tests) — 9/9 green

maria: :thumbsup: merging once ci passes. thanks team
